pages.user_job: Choose decorative sculptural shoulder pieces for a costume, stage, cosplay or festival look.
unique_modules: Shop by use context: performance / festival / cosplay using approved DNA only
Shop by confirmed material or visual effect such as mirror acrylic / mirror-coated vegan leather when represented in the membership
Related body pieces: arm pieces, harnesses, headpieces or complete looks through actual membership links
factual_guardrails: Decorative costume/fashion positioning only
Never describe as protective, ballistic, safety or historical armor unless Product Truth explicitly says so
faq_topics: How decorative shoulder pieces are worn/adjusted only when source facts support it
How to choose one-shoulder vs full-shoulder options where configuration truth exists
Care for mirror/acrylic or vegan-leather finishes from canonical care facts
